name: Julia Giannopoulos
title: Director, Richmond Hill
intro: Julia runs NAE's Richmond Hill studio: the instructors, the student experience from the first call to the certificate of completion, and the systems behind booking and enrolment.
description: Julia Giannopoulos, Director of NAE's Richmond Hill studio.
cta_line: Book a call and Julia's team will help you choose a course.

sections.heading: About Julia
sections.source: Julia's own description of her role (interviews, Aug 2026) and her instruction to write this bio (10 Nov 2026). Julia approves the wording.
body: Julia hires and supports NAE's instructors and makes sure every student knows what happens next, from booking a call to finishing their course.
Behind the scenes, Julia built the systems students use without noticing: online booking, secure checkout and the course records that follow each student from enquiry to completion.
